items.stem: Under Circular 230, what must a practitioner do upon learning a client has not complied with the revenue laws?

options.text: Immediately report the client to the IRS
options.rationale: Circular 230 does not require self-initiated reporting of the client to the IRS.

options.text: Advise the client promptly of the noncompliance and its consequences
options.rationale: Correct: the practitioner must inform the client of the noncompliance, error or omission and the consequences of not correcting it.

options.text: Resign from all engagements with the client
options.rationale: Resignation is not the required step; advising the client is.

options.text: Amend the return without telling the client
options.rationale: The practitioner cannot act without the client; the duty is to advise.

items.explanation: Correct: the practitioner must inform the client of the noncompliance, error or omission and the consequences of not correcting it.

items.stem: Which form grants an Enrolled Agent authority to represent a taxpayer before the IRS?

options.rationale: Form 8821 only authorizes access to information; it does not grant representation.

options.text: Form 2848, Power of Attorney and Declaration of Representative
options.rationale: Correct: Form 2848 grants representation authority to an eligible representative such as an EA.
